blocks.markdown: Today's big question: how does the weather change through the year?
blocks.say: Today we explore the seasons and the weather. How does the year change?

blocks.text: Stop 1: Four seasons in the UK

blocks.markdown:
The UK has four **seasons**: spring, summer, autumn and winter.

They come round in the same order every year.
blocks.say: A year is split into seasons. In the UK there are four. Spring is when new leaves and flowers grow, and baby animals are born. Summer is warm and sunny, with long days. Autumn is when leaves turn red and brown and fall. Winter is cold, with short days and sometimes snow. Then spring comes again. It is a circle that goes round and round.

blocks.alt: Heavy rain falling over green fields and tall trees under a grey sky
blocks.caption: Monsoon rain falls over green fields in summer.
blocks.credit: Photo by Mr Cool Hitman on Unsplash
blocks.say: This is monsoon rain. It falls in summer in Pakistan and makes the fields green.

blocks.markdown:
Pakistan has hot summers, a rainy **monsoon**, mild autumns and cool winters.

Different places have different weather in the same season.
blocks.say: In Pakistan the seasons look different. Summer is very hot. In many places the monsoon brings heavy rain in July and August. Autumn is mild. Winter is cool and sometimes it snows in the north, on the mountains. Then spring brings blossom, like almond flowers. So the same year has different weather in different countries.

blocks.alt: Monsoon rain, snowy mountains and spring blossom.
blocks.caption: Monsoon rain, snowy mountains and spring blossom.

question.prompt: When does the monsoon bring heavy rain to Pakistan?
question.explanation: The monsoon rains come in summer.

blocks.title: Zainab's year
blocks.transcript: In spring, blossom opens and lambs skip in the fields. In summer it is hot and the days are long. She wears a sun hat. In July the monsoon arrives. Heavy rain fills the streets. In autumn, leaves turn red and gold and fall to the ground. In winter it is cold. The northern mountains are covered in snow. Winter days are short. The sun sets early and the nights are long. A thermometer shows how hot or cold it is. Today it reads ten degrees. Zainab dresses for the weather. SubhanAllah, every season has its gifts!
blocks.caption: Zainab watches the seasons change from Lahore to the hills.

points: The four seasons are spring, summer, autumn and winter

blocks.say: Let us remember. A year has four seasons. They come in the same order. Places have different weather.

blocks.markdown:
**Weather** is what it is like outside: sunny, rainy, windy or cloudy.

It can change every day.
blocks.say: The weather is what it is like outside today. It can be sunny, rainy, windy, cloudy, snowy or foggy. It changes from day to day. Look at four kinds of weather.

blocks.say: A thermometer measures how hot or cold it is. The number on it is called the temperature. We measure it in degrees. The red line goes up when it is warm. It goes down when it is cold. Look at what happens on a hot day.

blocks.markdown:
A **thermometer** measures the **temperature**.

A high number means it is hot. A low number means it is cold.

blocks.markdown:
We choose clothes to suit the **weather**.

Warm clothes for cold days, light clothes for hot days.
blocks.say: We choose clothes to suit the season and the weather. In winter we wear a coat, a scarf and gloves. In hot summer we wear light clothes and a sun hat. On rainy days we need a raincoat and boots. In Ramadan or at Eid, we wear special clothes too. We still dress for the weather. Look at three outfits.

blocks.text: Stop 2: Stay safe in the sun

blocks.title: Sun safety plan
instructions: Draw yourself with a sun hat on.

blocks.say: The sun is strong in summer. Too much sun can burn our skin. So we wear a hat, drink water, and stay in the shade at midday. Never look straight at the sun, because it can hurt your eyes.
